The '''Endocray sector''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] that included the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Argovia]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
At some point of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] blockaded the Endocray sector, suspecting [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] activity in the area. The [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] used [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor cruisers]] and [[sensor net]]s to block all the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] leading through the sector.<ref name="AS" />

The Rebel Alliance launched an [[Mission to Argovia|operation]] to destroy the [[Imperial Sensor Net Complex|blockade control center]] on [[Argovia]]. The cargo ship [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Leona Makk]] managed in forcing the blockade and drove an Alliance strike team to the planet. After the destruction of the center, the Imperials couldn't maintain efficiently the blockade and the Endocray sector was reopened.<ref name="AS" />
